address: 121 Edmund Street, Birmingham, B3 2HJ, United Kingdom
bio: Run under the auspices of local chef Glynn Purnell, this tapas bar is a narrow, snaking spot that benefits from a prime location in Birmingham city centre. The menu lists a series of small plates including all your Spanish favourites like gambas, croquetas and patatas bravas – plus a predominantly Spanish wine list. For dessert, stay in Spain with a 'creme Catalana' or head back to Blighty with a sticky toffee pudding....
